g.text: ⚠ INTERCEPTED PACKET — ALL DATA VISIBLE TO ATTACKER
"Chest pain for 2 days, radiating to left arm"
RISK: Patient name, diagnosis, medications fully exposed
An attacker on the network sees EVERYTHING above in cleartext.
SAFE: Attacker sees only random bytes — no clinical data exposed
Patient: Rajesh Kumar, Dx: Acute Coronary
All clinical data encrypted before storage
Patient data is NEVER stored or transmitted in plaintext.
